Name: Ammihud, Father of Uthai
Summary: Father of Uthai in the Jerusalem list, son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:4: Father of Uthai in the Jerusalem list, son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ammihud in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
